# EditorSaves

> Universal save editor for game saves — RPG Maker, Ren'Py, Unity, Unreal Engine, and 23+ formats. Free, browser-based, no installation required.

EditorSaves is building a universal game save editor that works across many game engines and save formats. During Phase 1, the project collects real save files for format research while developing the editing system.

## Key Pages

- [Homepage](https://editorsaves.com/): Upload save files and learn about the universal save editor.
- [About](https://editorsaves.com/about): The mission and approach behind EditorSaves.
- [Blog](https://editorsaves.com/blog): Save file guides and format explanations.
- [Contact](https://editorsaves.com/contact): Get in touch with EditorSaves.

## Supported Formats

- RPG Maker MV/MZ: `.rpgsave`, `.rmmzsave`
- RPG Maker VX Ace/XP: `.rvdata2`, `.rxdata`
- Ren'Py: `.save`
- Unity: `.es3`, `.xml`, `.json`
- Unreal Engine: `.sav`
- SQLite: `.db`, `.sqlite3`
- JSON, XML, MessagePack, CBOR, Protocol Buffers, plist
- Python Pickle: `.pkl`
- Ruby Marshal: `.rxdata`
- Game-specific: Terraria (`.plr`, `.wld`), The Witcher 3 (`.sav`)

## Research Focus

EditorSaves studies how save files are serialized, compressed, and encoded across different engines to build reliable, safe editing tools. The project prioritizes accuracy, backups, and user control over broad claims.
